tests.name: npm dev releases Vite and Electron when only its launcher receives SIGTERM
npm dev releases Vite and Electron when only its launcher receives SIGHUP

assertions: Vite owns a process group separate from the launcher
Only the launcher PID receives the shutdown signal
npm, launcher, Vite, Electron, and captured children exit within 6 seconds
No helper or renderer remains in the owned process group
scope: Real npm run dev with isolated data/profile on macOS; Windows taskkill fallback not tested on Windows
